key.name: font
key.description: Full Pango font description (family, style, weight and size), for example “Cantarell Bold 27”.

key.name: reappear-delay
key.description: Mouse inactivity time before the clock reappears.

key.name: hide-in-fullscreen
key.summary: Hide the clock on screens showing a fullscreen window

key.name: position-mode
key.description: Position on screen: bottom right, bottom left, top right, top left, center, or custom position.

key.name: position-x
key.description: Relative horizontal position (0.0 = left, 1.0 = right). Only used when position-mode is "custom".

key.name: position-y
key.description: Relative vertical position (0.0 = top, 1.0 = bottom). Only used when position-mode is "custom".

key.name: stretch-to-screen
key.summary: Stretch the text to fill the screen
key.description: When enabled, the clock text is enlarged to fill the available screen space.

key.name: stretch-keep-ratio
key.summary: Keep aspect ratio in stretch mode
key.description: When enabled, the text is enlarged without distortion. Otherwise it is distorted to cover exactly the whole screen width and height.

key.name: split-flap
key.description: Show each digit on a tile that flips when the time changes, like old train station and airport boards.
